info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Loyalty Loyalty Rules-v1-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Rules Management API enables developers to access and manage loyalty program rules efficiently. It provides endpoints for retrieving comprehensive lists of existing loyalty rules, enhancing the ability to analyze and modify loyalty strategies. Typical consumers include loyalty program managers and marketing teams aiming to optimize user engagement and retention strategies. This API supports integrations with CRM systems and user interfaces to provide a seamless experience for managing customer loyalty programs.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current loyalty rules applicable to customers. It provides a structured response containing details about the rules, including any requirements or benefits associated with the loyalty program.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the loyalty rules. It contains the necessary parameters formatted in JSON, allowing the API to provide the relevant information regarding loyalty rules.

ListLoyaltyLoyaltyRulesRequest.description: Represents a request body for the operations related to loyalty rules retrieval.
